title: GENTM still in sideway
author: VikiSoh
body: GENM downtrend now from monthly chart. Weekly chart, I can see the price movements have become slow and in a sideway Daily Chart - I think i can have a small investment in the sideway box. To be safe, i put my SL and TP and RR is 1.5:3?

title: Genting on its way down to close its previous gap
author: Junichiro
body: Given the global economic turmoil, Genting might well be on its way to trend below RM3.00 to close its previous gap. The gap lies within the fibo 0.786 while the lower support level is around RM2.50
